analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — the $23.06 near-miss

August 7, 2026 was the most significant single session in the step-aside framework's history. The July NFP miss (−23,000 jobs vs. +83,000 expected) delivered the strongest possible macro catalyst for BTC at 12:30 UTC — and BTC responded with its highest session price of the step-aside period ($65,396.97 at 12:00 UTC). The reference close at 20:00 UTC came in at $64,976.94 — just $23.06 below the $65,000 step-aside threshold.

The reference candle itself (20:00 UTC): open $64,960.16, high $65,045.08, low $64,947.27, close $64,976.94, volume 56.40 BTC. The high of $65,045.08 represents the fourth intraday penetration of the $65,000 level during the step-aside period — but the close of $64,976.94 means Condition 1 (reference close > $65,000) was not met by $23.06.

### Full session candle map (Crypto.com 1h, verified)

| 12:00 | $65,027 | **$65,397** | $64,975 | $65,294 | 150.54 | ★ NFP release — session high |

| **20:00** | $64,960 | **$65,045** | $64,947 | **$64,977** | **56.40** | ★ Reference close — $23.06 short |

### Gap trajectory — 95.9% compression in a single session

The step-aside gap has never moved this dramatically in a single session:

| Date | Reference Close | Gap to $65K |
|---|---|---|
| Aug 1 | $62,659 | $2,341 |
| Aug 2 | $63,439 | $1,561 |
| Aug 3 | $63,789 | $1,211 |
| Aug 4 | $64,352 | $648 |
| Aug 5 | $64,830 | $170 |
| Aug 6 | $64,441 | $559 (re-expansion) |
| **Aug 7** | **$64,977** | **$23.06 (95.9% compression from Aug 6)** |

The previous single-day maximum compression was Aug 5 (gap narrowed $523 from $648 to $170). Aug 7 compressed $536 — a new record for single-day gap reduction.

### The four intraday $65K breaches — pattern analysis

1. **Aug 5, 20:00 UTC**: reference candle high $65,044.22 — reference close $64,830.30 (gap $170)
2. **Aug 6, 05:00 UTC**: candle high $65,009.60 — candle close $64,913.31 (Asian session)
3. **Aug 6, 08:00 UTC**: candle high $65,005.81 — candle close $64,944.95 (London open)
4. **Aug 7, 20:00 UTC**: **reference candle high $65,045.08** — reference close $64,976.94 (gap $23.06)

The pattern: each successive breach is occurring closer to the reference candle's own close. The Aug 5 breach was 214 ticks above the reference close ($65,044 high vs $64,830 close); the Aug 7 reference candle breach was only 68 ticks above the reference close ($65,045 high vs $64,977 close). The options gamma wall is providing less protection with each test — the delta-hedging mechanism is becoming less effective as the gap narrows.

### Trend — ascending channel restored; strongest single-session recovery in the period

After the Aug 6 channel break (gap re-expanded from $170 to $559), Aug 7 restored and extended the narrowing trend with a $536 single-session compression. The reference close at $64,977 is the highest reference close in the step-aside period, surpassing the prior peak of $64,830 (Aug 5). The ascending reference close structure: $62,659 → $63,789 → $64,352 → $64,830 → [Aug 6 regression to $64,441] → $64,977 (new peak).

### Momentum — four-session best; RSI approaching overbought

The $536 reference close gain on Aug 7 is the largest single-session reference close gain in the step-aside period. BTC RSI (estimated) has moved from ~45 (Aug 6) to ~58–62 (Aug 7) — neutral to modestly bullish territory. The NFP catalyst has injected sustained buying momentum across all time frames. The risk of an overbought RSI pullback is mitigated by the fact that the reference close is still below the key $65,000 level — BTC has not actually 'broken out' from a technical standpoint yet.

### Volume — NFP surge: 3 heaviest candles in 90 minutes; reference close: orderly

The three post-NFP candles (12:00–14:00 UTC) accounted for 512 of the session's ~1,330 total BTC — 38.5% of all session volume compressed into 3 hours. The 14:00 UTC candle (210 BTC) was the 'sell the news' candle that pulled BTC from $65,280 to $64,950. The reference close candle (56.40 BTC) was near-identical to Aug 6's reference candle (56.83 BTC) — orderly, light, no institutional directional push.
